steps.name: Lint, typecheck, and migration checks
steps.run: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:migration && node scripts/verify-observability-configs.mjs --root . --tool-mode container

steps.name: Create Python test environment
steps.run: python3 -m venv .ci-venv && .ci-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .ci-venv/bin/pip install -r apps/engine/requirements.txt -r apps/worker/requirements.txt

steps.name: Run Python suites
steps.run: (cd apps/engine && ../../.ci-venv/bin/python -m pytest --cov=src --cov-fail-under=90) && (cd apps/worker && ../../.ci-venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests)
